items.title: Donn Andre interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, June 6, 2009
items.q: we got that job through the auspices of a fellow named Dave Cook, a clarinet player with the Dartmouth Indian Chiefs

ctx.x: Yeah, we got that job through the auspices of a fellow named Dave Cook, a clarinet player with the Dartmouth Indian Chiefs, which was a band that was one of our — I wouldn’t say rivals because we operated in a different market. But he had suggested to Jim Carpenter, who was running these college jazz bands that go to Carnegie Hall that we were a pretty good band and give us a try. So we did and they did, and we ended up playing opposite an all-star band from the Central Plaza in New York. We played two sets each…
